posts.title: Free leaf pickup through December 4
posts.body:
Groot Waste Management is collecting bagged leaves for free from **Monday, October 19 through Friday, December 4, 2026**. No yard waste sticker is needed during those six weeks.

- Use 30-gallon **paper** yard waste bags.
- Put the bags at the curb by **6 a.m. on your regular garbage day**.

This is a City of Aurora program. Questions: call 311 or 630-256-4636, or see the [City’s announcement](https://www.aurora.il.us/News-articles/Free-Leaf-Pickup).

posts.title: District 308 referendum: community meet & greet
posts.body: Oswego Community Unit School District 308 is hosting an informational meeting about the proposed **Update 308** referendum, covering the district’s facility and infrastructure needs, the proposal itself and its potential tax impact. Residents can meet district leadership and ask questions.

updates.title: Communication
updates.body: The Board is putting new initiatives in place so residents get timely, relevant information.

updates.title: Governing documents review
updates.body: The Declaration dates to 1998 and is being revised to reflect current Illinois law. The Board is reviewing the attorney’s draft alongside declarations from neighboring communities. Want to give input? Email the Board at wheatlandshoa@gmail.com.

updates.title: Short-term rentals
updates.body: The Board took action on the short-term rental (Airbnb) in the neighborhood. A [Short-Term Rental Resolution](/uploads/7/2/1/6/7216816/09.17.2026.short_term_rental.v.signed.pdf) has since been signed.

updates.title: Monument repair
updates.body: Repair is underway. A contractor has been selected for both the stone and wrought iron work, and the at-fault driver’s insurance is covering the cost. The Wheatlands sign was taken down to protect it and will go back up once the monument is restored. Completion is expected around mid-November.

updates.title: Fence repairs
updates.body: Effective January 1, 2026, homeowners are expected to promptly repair damaged fencing. Unrepaired damage may be subject to fines under Association policy.

updates.title: Barrington / Eola fence
updates.body: The unapproved fence at the southwest corner of Barrington and Eola was removed and replaced with a fence that meets the Declaration.

updates.title: Monument lighting
updates.body: Monuments at the Reserve and at the northwest corner of Barrington and Haefenrichter now have LED lights for better visibility and longevity.

updates.title: Electronic communication
updates.body: A letter asking for permission to communicate by email was mailed to all homeowners on September 17, 2026. Please fill it out and return it by mail or email; a name is needed, but no signature. Email lets the Board share the budget, the revised Declaration and other news faster and at lower cost.

updates.title: Open meetings
updates.body: All meetings are being held as open meetings beginning August 2026.
